definitions.gloss: pick-up artist; man who habitually hits on strangers
definitions.explanation: A man skilled at, or in the habit of, approaching and picking up people he does not know, especially women in public places. Casual and often disparaging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ナンパ{師|し}だ。

examples.english: A pick-up artist hit on me in town.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ナンパ{師|し}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気|き}をつけた→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: That place attracts a lot of pick-up artists, so you'd better be careful.

notes:
USAGE: ナンパ{師|し} combines ⟦ナンパ→ナンパ：09312_nanpa⟧ (picking someone up romantically) with the suffix {師|し} (a person skilled in an activity). It is casual and usually carries a negative or joking tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナンパ{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかる→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧: to fall for a pick-up artist
- ⟦{自称|じしょう}→自称：13937_jishou⟧ナンパ{師|し}: a self-proclaimed pick-up artist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ナンパ→ナンパ：09312_nanpa⟧: hitting on someone — the act itself
- {遊|あそ}び{人|にん}: a playboy — someone who plays around romantically
